system.description: Beginning at 20th level, you can unleash your accelerated chakra to control and manipulate the mobility of others. At the beginning of other creatures turn, you can spend 1 superiority die, targeting them. You each roll 1d20, and add half of your current movement speed and compare results. If your result is higher, you are able to steal the enhanced mobility of the opposing creature, as they gain the Slowed condition and you immediately cast anyone of the jutsu gained from the Mobile Savant class feature at no chakra cost.
